notes:
New
• Home: continue your latest project, see Premiere at a glance, start a Cut Video or Fully Edit Video project in one line, and find recent projects, references and creator styles
• Search in the top bar finds projects, references, assets, presets and commands (Ctrl P)
• Your profile in the top right: change your display name and photo, see your plan, and sign out
• Projects can be renamed and duplicated (same footage and settings, no edits copied)
• References: "Use as Inspiration" starts a new project with that style, and a YouTube link that can't load offers Retry or Upload Video Instead
• Presets shows creator styles and styles learned from your references, with what each one does

Fixed
• Revisions now always edit Premiere once an edit exists. They were being saved as notes whenever Premiere's timeline didn't match Solis exactly
• A revision that fails stays a revision, marked Failed with the reason and a Retry button
• Repeated words, stutters and false starts are cut: Solis now transcribes speech word for word (it used to receive a cleaned-up transcript that hid them) and repairs word timings so they can be found
• Captions no longer show "uh" and "um"

Testing
• Try a revision such as "cut the first hello" and check it changes the Premiere timeline
• Check that false starts in a new edit are removed
